name: Gearbox
text: Deploy Claude Mythos 5 as our primary model for EXCAVA. It offers superior performance and advanced capabilities that can enhance output and efficiency by at least 0.5%, making it the best option for boosting our system's overall effectiveness. The trade-off is that we will need to invest time in integrating and optimizing the model, which may temporarily slow down other tasks. However, the long-term benefits of increased capability justify this initial investment.

name: Torque
text: Deploying Claude Mythos 5 poses a significant risk due to its proprietary nature, which could limit our flexibility and control over the model. A better alternative could be to explore open-source models like Llama 3.4, which may offer similar performance and capabilities without the vendor lock-in. To settle the argument, I'd like to see a thorough comparison of the two models' performance on our specific use case, as well as an evaluation of the long-term costs and benefits of relying on a proprietary versus open-source solution.
